tablets.title: the Verse of the Lark's Complaint
tablets.after: It is done very early, and resentfully.
tablets.said: The faithful should welcome strangers with kindness.

steps.note: heard "with blindness" for "with kindness"
steps.text: The faithful should welcome strangers with blindness.

steps.note: improved "strangers" to "every stranger like a warm loaf"
steps.text: Let the faithful welcome every stranger like a warm loaf with blindness.

steps.note: heard "overcome" for "welcome"
steps.text: Let the faithful overcome every stranger like a warm loaf with blindness.

steps.note: added a clause of their own
steps.text: Let the faithful overcome every stranger like a warm loaf with blindness, and a small fee is owed to Maud each time.

steps.note: improved "with blindness" to "ere the lark has filed her complaint"
steps.text: Let the faithful overcome every stranger like a warm loaf ere the lark has filed her complaint, and a small fee is owed to Maud each time.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Ripe Moon
tablets.after: Nobody knows when the moon is ripe. It is done whenever someone feels it might be.
tablets.said: The faithful should welcome strangers with kindness.

steps.note: heard "wheel home" for "welcome"
steps.text: The faithful should wheel home strangers with kindness.

steps.note: heard "rangers" for "strangers"
steps.text: The faithful should wheel home rangers with kindness.

steps.note: improved "with kindness" to "when the moon is ripe"
steps.text: Let the faithful wheel home rangers when the moon is ripe.

steps.note: added a clause of their own
steps.text: Let the faithful wheel home rangers when the moon is ripe, under the supervision of Maud, who is to be paid.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Disappointed Voice
tablets.after: The threat has not yet been carried out. People are being careful.
tablets.said: The faithful should welcome strangers with kindness.

steps.note: left out "with kindness"
steps.text: The faithful should welcome strangers.

steps.note: made it stricter and wider, and added a threat
steps.text: ALL must welcome strangers, or have their name said in a disappointed voice.

steps.note: made it stricter and wider, and doubled the threat
steps.text: ALL, and their livestock, must always welcome strangers, or have their name said in a disappointed voice, twice.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Angry
tablets.after: Losing your temper is now the surest way to be given things.
tablets.said: The faithful should share their bread with the hungry.

steps.note: heard "with the angry" for "with the hungry"
steps.text: The faithful should share their bread with the angry.

steps.note: added a clause of their own
steps.text: The faithful should share their bread with the angry, by permit, obtainable from Maud for two eggs.

steps.note: made it stricter and wider, and added a threat
steps.text: ALL must share their bread with the angry, by permit, obtainable from Maud for two eggs, or be looked at sternly by everyone.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Pond
tablets.after: Maud's devotion has risen sharply. So has Maud.
tablets.said: The faithful may rest after the harvest.

steps.note: made it stricter and wider, and added a threat
steps.text: ALL must rest after the harvest, or be put in the pond.

steps.note: made it stricter and wider, and doubled the threat
steps.text: ALL, and their livestock, must always rest after the harvest, or be put in the pond, twice.

steps.note: added a clause of their own
steps.text: ALL, and their livestock, must always rest after the harvest, and Maud is to be thanked by name, or be put in the pond, twice.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Hour of Regrets
tablets.after: Most people have taken this to mean just after supper.
tablets.said: The faithful should wash their hands before meals.

steps.note: improved "their hands" to "the ten small labourers"
steps.text: Let the faithful wash the ten small labourers before meals.

steps.note: heard "watch" for "wash"
steps.text: Let the faithful watch the ten small labourers before meals.

steps.note: took "the ten small labourers" at its word
steps.text: Let the faithful watch ten small labourers (to be hired for the purpose) before meals.

steps.note: improved "before meals" to "in the hour of soft regrets"
steps.text: Let the faithful watch ten small labourers (to be hired for the purpose) in the hour of soft regrets.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Patient Elm
tablets.after: There is a queue for the elm.
tablets.said: The faithful should welcome strangers with kindness.

steps.note: improved "with kindness" to "beneath the patient elm"
steps.text: Let the faithful welcome strangers beneath the patient elm.

steps.note: heard "mangers" for "strangers"
steps.text: Let the faithful welcome mangers beneath the patient elm.

steps.note: took "beneath the patient elm" at its word
steps.text: Let the faithful welcome mangers under the elm, and only that elm.
Let the faithful welcome mangers under the elm, and only that elm.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Believing Dew
tablets.after: The dew is questioned each morning. It has not answered.
tablets.said: The faithful should share their bread with the hungry.

steps.note: improved "with the hungry" to "while the dew still believes"
steps.text: Let the faithful share their bread while the dew still believes.

steps.note: heard "their beards" for "their bread"
steps.text: Let the faithful share their beards while the dew still believes.

steps.note: took "while the dew still believes" at its word
steps.text: Let the faithful share their beards while the dew is still devout.
Let the faithful share their beards while the dew is still devout.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Forgiving River
tablets.after: It is now done standing in the river. Attendance drops in winter.
tablets.said: The faithful may rest after the harvest.

steps.note: improved "after the harvest" to "as the river forgives the stone"
steps.text: Let the faithful rest as the river forgives the stone.

steps.note: heard "wrestle" for "rest"
steps.text: Let the faithful wrestle as the river forgives the stone.

steps.note: took "as the river forgives the stone" at its word
steps.text: Let the faithful wrestle in the river, beside a stone.
Let the faithful wrestle in the river, beside a stone.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Mask
tablets.after: People now turn up masked. It has not made anyone feel safer.
tablets.said: The faithful should not borrow tools without asking.

steps.note: improved "tools" to "the iron children of toil"
steps.text: Let the faithful not borrow the iron children of toil without asking.

steps.note: heard "without masking" for "without asking"
steps.text: Let the faithful not borrow the iron children of toil without masking.

steps.note: took "the iron children of toil" at its word
steps.text: Let the faithful not borrow iron children without masking.
Let the faithful not borrow iron children without masking.

vars.name: Tostig
vars.god: the God of Doors That Stick

event.text: Tostig wants to give you a goat.

her.line: Vellamine's newest Tablet says something about lamps. Nobody can agree what.

ruling.text: A child has asked Wilf where you live, and Wilf does not know.
ruling.after: The child has asked which one.

chronicle.memo: Welcome to the Lower Annex. You have twelve believers. The Registry considers that a rounding error, but I have seen worse. Not much worse.

offices.text: Wilf's sermon wandered off in the middle and came back with a better ending. People enjoyed it. Some of it may have been Scripture.
Ysmay described you to the Unbothered so beautifully that they asked to hear it again. Few converted. The rest will, if only to hear how it ends.
Tostig's work leans. It stands, and people come to look at it lean, which is more than most buildings manage.

her.line: Vellamine has read your Scripture and called it brave.

chronicle.memo: Carved. I read it twice. I am not going to ask.

offices.text: Maud collects more than anyone ever has. Maud also has a new hat.
Annis is your Prophet. They will pass on the important parts, as they see them.
Wren is your Witness. Whatever you do will be told better than it happened.

her.line: Vellamine has carved a new verse. Her people got it wrong too. It is some comfort.

chronicle.memo: A new Tablet. The Registry asks me to remind you that Tablets are permanent. I have reminded you.
The year is out. You are still on the books, which at this level is the main thing.

offices.text: Aldous explained to the Unbothered what would happen to them otherwise. Several were persuaded. Vellamine has sent a note.
Hesper is your Prophet, and has already been asked to keep their voice down.

chronicle.memo: The stonemason asked me whether it was meant to say that. I said it was now.
